comparison.objective: Support a precision bar with one arm before withdrawing its carriage with the other.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered bimanual load transfer and relative-clearance creation.
comparison.success_condition: Bar remains continuously supported while the carriage is genuinely withdrawn; exact clearance and support thresholds are not present in the body.
comparison.reason: This is support handoff and extraction sequencing, not fastener/collar manipulation or iterative dynamic commissioning.
